findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_mac_serial" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_mac_listing · Private data: lookup_mac_serial, get_macfax_credit_balance · Public sink: create_mac_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_mac_listing · Private data: lookup_mac_serial, get_macfax_credit_balance · Public sink: create_mac_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
